summary: Frontend-only read-only verification of the Dynopay Operations Console redesign: (1) unified DetailSlideOver across Transactions / Pay-links / Customers and (2) date-band grouping on the Transactions table. Verified desktop 1920 + mobile 390, light + dark. All three slide-overs open from the right, share the same ~480px chrome, close via their dedicated testids. Date-band headers appear on default date sort and correctly disappear when sorting by Amount or USD Value, and reappear when sort returns to date. Mobile customer slide-over is now a full-width right sheet (x=0, w=390) and closes cleanly. No functional console errors; only Cloudflare rate-limit (429/MIME) noise unrelated to the features.

verified_checks.dark_mode_rendering: verified on /transactions (mobile) and chrome visually clean on /pay-links, /customers
verified_checks.console_noise: Cloudflare 429 + MIME-type refusals for Next chunks on second run (infra/rate-limit, not app bugs)

critical_code_review_comments: Observation only — could not re-verify identified-customer customer-detail-copy-email + customer-detail-crm testids in the final dark-mode retry because Cloudflare threw a bot-challenge mid-run. The anonymous flow confirmed those are correctly omitted, and previous iterations already exercised identified customers. If main agent wants belt-and-suspenders, run one more pass hitting an identified customer card after the current session warms up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: set sessionStorage.mfa_interstitial_seen='1' BEFORE visiting /auth/login; email -> Continue -> password -> signin-submit-btn -> dialog has 6 individual OTP inputs (data-testid='login-2fa-dialog'). Dark mode: localStorage theme-mode-inapp='dark' set via add_init_script. Preview is behind Cloudflare and aggressively rate-limits chunk loads on back-to-back runs; keep sessions compact or add longer waits between navigations. Date-band testids: tx-group-{today|yesterday|week|month|earlier} desktop and tx-group-m-* mobile; only rendered when sort.key==='dateTime'.
